capture.review.title: Payments to check
capture.review.intro: Payments that arrived on their own from the iPhone. Recorded ones already count in your figures; proposals don't count until you record them.
capture.review.rejectedHelp: If the payment didn't go through, “It was declined” moves it to the trash and it stops counting.
capture.proposal.why.autoSaveOff: “Save automatically” is off: record it if it's right.
capture.proposal.why.manual: It wasn't recorded automatically: record it if it's right.
capture.proposal.why.duplicate: It looks like another expense of the same amount less than 2 minutes apart: it may be the same payment.
capture.proposal.why.foreign: It came in {currency} ({original}). Clara doesn't convert currencies: enter what was charged in {budget}.
capture.proposal.why.ambiguous: It came as “{original}”: ¥ can be yen or yuan and Clara doesn't guess. Enter what was charged in {budget}.
capture.proposal.why.unparsed: The amount wasn't understood (“{original}”). Enter what was charged in {budget}.
capture.proposal.amountHelp: What was charged in your currency: check Wallet or your bank.
capture.proposal.why.test: It's the test from Settings: it came the same way as an Apple Pay payment. It doesn't count in any figure; discard it.
capture.settings.intro: Clara can note your Apple Pay payments on its own: a Shortcuts automation runs the “Record payment in Clara” action after each payment and Clara reads it when it opens. Nothing leaves your iPhone and Clara never connects to your bank.
capture.settings.autoSaveHelp: On: a payment in {currency} comes in as a real expense marked “To check” and counts right away. Off: it stays a proposal and doesn't count until you record it. Another currency or a possible duplicate always stays a proposal.
capture.settings.defaultAccountHelp: If you pick none, the first active budget account.
capture.settings.cardsHelp: Type the card name as Shortcuts passes it (for example “Visa ••1234”) and choose its account. A credit card goes to its card account.
capture.settings.cardDuplicate: That card is already on the list.
capture.settings.guideTitle: How to turn it on in your iPhone
capture.settings.guide1: Open the Shortcuts app and go to “Automation”.
capture.settings.guide2: Create a new automation with the Wallet transaction trigger and choose your cards.
capture.settings.guide3: Set it to run without asking for confirmation.
capture.settings.guide4: Add the “Record payment in Clara” action and pass it the amount, the merchant and, if you like, the card of the transaction.
capture.settings.guide5: Pay with Apple Pay and open Clara: the payment will be in To review › Payments to check.
capture.settings.guideNote: Shortcuts menu names may change with the iOS version.
capture.settings.testHelp: Notes a test payment of {amount} the same way as a real payment. It shows up in To review as “Test”, counts in no figure and is discarded with one tap.
capture.settings.testOk: It works: the test is in To review › Payments to check.
capture.settings.testFailed: The test couldn't be noted. Try again; if it keeps failing, close and reopen Clara.
